post.summary: Submit a task for AI processing through the confidence gate
post.description: Submits a pre-processed task (clientAccountId + aiOutput + rawConfidence) through the confidence gate. Returns HITL_QUEUE (202) if confidence is insufficient, or AUTO_FLOW (200) if the calibrated confidence exceeds the threshold.

202.description: HITL_QUEUE — task queued for human validator

422.description: 422 — HARD_REJECT (structural error) or BLOCK (confidence in [0.30, 0.50) — retry recommended)

post.summary: Natural language chat — runs AI inference then routes through the confidence gate
post.description: Accepts a natural language message, runs offline AI inference, calibrates confidence, and routes through the gate. Always returns 200 — HARD_REJECT is mapped to HITL_QUEUE for the chat use-case.

200.description: Chat response with verdict and AI output

get.summary: List approvals in the HITL queue
get.description: Returns approvals matching the status filter with cursor-based pagination. Requires validator JWT in production (DEV_PASSTHROUGH when VALIDATOR_JWT_SECRET is not set).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. 'all' returns every approval regardless of state.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return results after this approval ID (exclusive).

post.summary: Resolve an approval — validator approve/reject/modify decision
post.description: A validator resolves a pending approval. On approve/modify, the 40/40/20 ledger split is executed and the validator account is credited. Requires validator JWT.

200.description: Approval resolved; ledger split details included

post.summary: Issue a validator JWT token for UI authentication
post.description: Validates the password against VALIDATOR_LOGIN_PASSWORD and issues a signed JWT (8h TTL) for use on validator-protected endpoints. Returns 503 if secrets are not configured.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (5 attempts per 15 minutes per IP)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

503.description: Server misconfiguration — VALIDATOR_LOGIN_PASSWORD or VALIDATOR_JWT_SECRET not set

get.summary: SSE stream for real-time validator UI updates
get.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Broadcasts approval creation and resolution events to connected validator UIs. Keep connection open; events are pushed as `data: <JSON>\n\n`.

get.summary: Full mission detail with approval and audit trail

200.description: Mission snapshot with approval, splits, and audit entries

post.summary: Fund a client account (authenticated B2B deposit)
post.description: Credits a client account. Idempotent via `idempotencyKey`. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <ECOS_DEPOSIT_API_KEY>` header. DEV_PASSTHROUGH mode when key is not set.

422.description: Idempotency key conflict — same key used with different request body

post.description: Debits the validator ledger account and initiates a Stripe Connect transfer. Currently uses a mock provider unless STRIPE_API_KEY is set. Requires validator JWT.

get.summary: Get account balance
Get validator earnings for today (royalty-aware)
get.description: Returns task earnings (40% of resolved approvals) + royalty earnings (ROYALTY_PAID audit entries) for the specified validator, scoped to today's UTC date. Requires validator JWT.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Override the date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today UTC.

get.summary: System health check — always 200
Aggregated system stats — always 200
get.description: Returns version, uptime, calibrator state, chain length, ledger balances, approval counts, top validators, and DB status. Always 200 even on internal error.

get.summary: Prometheus-format gauge metrics — always 200
get.description: Returns 10 Prometheus gauges in plain text (format 0.0.4). Always 200. Content-Type: text/plain.

get.summary: Verify audit chain integrity (SHA-256 hash chain)
Get the most recent audit log entry (chain head)
get.description: Returns the head entry of the in-memory audit chain. If the chain is empty, returns all-null fields. Always 200.

get.summary: Returns calibrator status including nextFitUrl when not yet ready.

200.description: Returns calibrator status including nextFitUrl when not yet ready.

post.summary: Fit the confidence calibrator with labeled data
post.description: Runs Platt scaling (sigmoid fit) on the provided labeled samples. Requires ≥10 samples. Persists params to DB (preferred) and JSON file fallback.

get.summary: Fetch labeled training data from the DB
get.description: Returns up to `limit` approval records with non-null confidence values, formatted as {rawScore, label} for use with POST /api/v1/calibrator/fit. Returns empty array when DB is not connected.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of training samples to return (default 500, max 1000)

hasMore.description: True when the number of results equals the requested limit, indicating more rows may exist

post.summary: ReAct agent — multi-step reasoning with tools
post.description: Runs a ReAct loop (max 5 steps) using the LLM with access to tools: check_calibrator, list_pending, get_balance, run_verify, list_approvals_all, list_patches. Returns a final_answer when the loop completes.

200.description: Agent result with final answer and step trace

get.summary: List knowledge patches (semantic patch library)
get.description: Returns active knowledge patches from the DB with cursor-based pagination, ordered by reuse count. Returns empty array when DB is not connected.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return results after this patch ID (exclusive).

post.description: Executes the 40/40/20 ledger split directly without going through the gate or HITL queue. Kept for backward compatibility.

get.summary: [Legacy] Full simulation state snapshot
get.description: Returns the content of simulation_state.json if it exists.

get.summary: Lightweight version probe — returns version, semver, buildTime, nodeVersion, gitCommit

gitCommit.description: Short git commit hash at server start, or null if git unavailable

Global recent events (newest-first, cursor-paginated)

post.summary: Register a webhook URL for an account

delete.summary: Remove a registered webhook for an account

post.summary: [V101] Bulk-resolve multiple approvals in one call
post.description: Resolve up to 50 approvals in a single request. Each item is processed independently; partial success is returned.

get.summary: [V101] Webhook delivery log (ring buffer, last 200 attempts)
get.description: Returns the last N webhook delivery attempts. Default limit=50, max=200.

get.summary: [V102] Persistent agent identity
get.description: Returns the stable UUID for this agent instance. The ID is generated once at first boot, persisted to .agent-identity.json (and DB when available), and reloaded on every restart.

agentId.description: Stable UUID for this agent instance

get.summary: [V102] External audit chain verifier
get.description: Returns a verifiable proof of the current audit chain state. External parties can store headHash and compare on subsequent calls — any mutation of a past entry will change headHash. intact=false means the chain has been tampered with and brokenAt/reason indicate where.

intact.description: True if full chain verification passes

headHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the latest entry

brokenAt.description: Entry index where chain breaks (null if intact)

PrometheusMetrics.description: Prometheus plain-text format (0.0.4). Contains 10 gauges: ecos_uptime_seconds, ecos_chain_length, ecos_calibrator_samples, ecos_calibrator_ready, ecos_pending_approvals, ecos_db_connected, ecos_chain_verify_ok, ecos_total_approvals, ecos_platform_balance_usd, ecos_insurance_balance_usd.
PrometheusMetrics.example:
# HELP ecos_uptime_seconds Server uptime in seconds
# TYPE ecos_uptime_seconds gauge
ecos_uptime_seconds 3601.2

text.example: Review this contract for liability gaps.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional — same key + same body → 200 replay (no double credit). Same key + different body → 422.

mock.description: true when STRIPE_API_KEY is not configured
